sources.summary: Renders and construction images of the upcoming London Museum in Smithfield, by architecture studios Stanton Williams and Asif Khan with conservation architects Julian Harrap Architects, have been released ahead of its opening later this year. The museum, which will showcase London's history and replace the existing Museum of London that is set to be demolished, The post Images of relocated London Museum by Stanton Williams and Asif Khan revealed appeared first on Dezeen .
